messages.subject: JGRConnector error (java.lang.NullPointerException)
parts:
Hi, I've seen a few references to this issue but none of the suggestions in other threads seem to work.
I'm a new user to R.
I've installed R version 3.2.1 Patched
I've reinstalled Java 64 bit
I've added Deducer by
install.packages(c("JGR","Deducer","DeducerExtras"))
library(JGR)
JGR()
When the Deducer console loads it starts generating a raft of errors. I've copied the top part of the console below, as well as sessionInfo() further down
Could someone suggest an approach to resolve the errors?
Thanks
- Mick

messages.subject: Re: JGRConnector error (java.lang.NullPointerException)
parts:
It seems that the issue arises when I follow the instructions here: http://www.deducer.org/pmwiki/index.php?n=Main.LoadDeducerByDefaultAtStart-up
I've added the lines of code to the file specified, but then have the issue listed above. If I comment out those lines, then the issue goes away.
I would be nice to have Deducer load by default though - any clues on how to fix?
Thanks
- Mick

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: JGRConnector error (java.lang.NullPointerException)
parts:
Yes, you should not have those lines if you are using JGR. It will make R try to load Deducer before JGR. To have Deducer load on start-up follow the bolded instructions on that page and cick default next to Deducer in the package manager.

Ian
